name: mcpilot
description: MCPilot: WooCommerce Hosting & Team MCP Gateway on Kubernetes

scripts.docker:build: docker build -t mcpilot-gateway:latest ./gateway && docker build -t mcpilot-woocommerce-mcp:latest ./mcp-servers/woocommerce && docker build -t mcpilot-analytics-mcp:latest ./mcp-servers/analytics && docker build -t mcpilot-time-mcp:latest ./mcp-servers/time && docker build -t mcpilot-store-init:latest ./docker/store-init
scripts.k3d:import: k3d image import mcpilot-gateway:latest mcpilot-woocommerce-mcp:latest mcpilot-analytics-mcp:latest mcpilot-time-mcp:latest mcpilot-store-init:latest -c mcpilot
